discover_builtin_tools: discover and import all self-registering tool modules from a tools directory
register_tool: register a new tool with schema, handler, toolset, and availability check in the central registry
deregister_tool: remove a registered tool from the registry and clean up its toolset check if last
get_tool_definitions: get OpenAI-format tool schema definitions filtered by availability check results
dispatch_tool: execute a registered tool handler by name with args and return JSON result or error
